description.value: Lachi is a family-owned Indian restaurant founded in 2009 by Jaswinder and Surinder Pal, who drew on their culinary roots from Punjab, India, to bring authentic curries, tandoori dishes, and biryanis to Penticton's 500 block of Main Street. The cozy, low-lit bistro-style space uses locally sourced Okanagan ingredients and offers a broad menu spanning everything from butter chicken and vindaloo to a dedicated vegetarian specialties section. Dine-in and takeout are both available, and the restaurant also carries wine, beer, and spirits.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at lachi.ca is fully accessible and provides strong evidence. The homepage confirms takeout availability ('get take-out if you are having company over or in a rush') and OSM corroborates with takeaway=yes. The menu's dedicated 'Vegetarian Specialties' section and the website copy ('a large variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes') confirm vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site. An address discrepancy exists internally on the website: the footer consistently shows 504 Main Street while some body text sections reference 510 Main Street; the homepage explicitly states they 'successfully moved to our new location at 504 Main Street,' making 504 the current address.
concerns: Address inconsistency within website: footer on multiple pages shows 504 Main Street (V2A 5C7) as the current address, while body text on the contact and about-us subpages references 510 Main Street; homepage explicitly states the business moved to 504 Main Street, so 504 is used here. OSM carries no address to cross-check against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, established, publicly accessible Indian restaurant operating since 2009 in downtown Penticton with an active website and menu.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'Vegetarian Specialties' menu section; website copy states 'a large variety of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes.'
